Adrift Afloat by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 With a sparkling private pool and an adorable carriage house, Adrift Afloat is a fantastic vacation sanctuary in Eastern Lake Estates. This gorgeous 7-bedroom home offers plenty of room with a 4-bedroom main house and a charming 3-bedroom carriage house, perfect for big families or groups. Between the homes is a private oasis with a sparkling pool, relaxing spill-over spa, and an outdoor dining area featuring a gas grill, setting the stage for unforgettable gatherings. Inside the main house, the living room welcomes you with a comfy sectional. The dining area seats eight, and the modern, airy kitchen is fully equipped for any culinary adventure, with extra seating at the island. There's also a cozy bunk room with full-over-full bunks, a full trundle, and an additional twin with a trundle, plus a full bathroom on this floor. Upstairs, three serene bedrooms—each with a TV, private bath, and balcony—await. The primary suite is a true escape with a soaking tub, a separate shower, and a private balcony that's perfect for morning coffee. The carriage house across the pool is just as inviting. Its sunlit open living area includes a full kitchen, dining space for seven, and a twin-over-twin bunk room with a private bath.

A guest bedroom, queen, on the first floor comes with a seating area and its own patio access, while the entire second level is reserved for the primary bedroom, queen, with a private bath, wet bar, and a balcony for soaking up the Florida sunshine. In the heart of Seagrove, you're just a short walk from local dining, coffee shops, and more. Plus, the 20-mile Timpoochee bike trail nearby gives you access to explore all the beauty of 30A, from Seaside and Grayton Beach to Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Embrace the laid-back lifestyle of Seagrove and 30A with a stay at Adrift Afloat, where relaxation and adventure meet in perfect harmony. Very nice! Overview: - .2 miles to the beach (Eastern Lake Access) In the event of a high outflow at the Eastern Lake access point, please use the Ramsgate access to the west. - 7 bedroom, 7 bath - 3716 sq ft - Private pool (can be heated seasonally for an additional $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) - Gas grill - Wi-Fi included - 4 bikes included - Parking limited to 4 vehicles with no street parking - Dogs considered under 50 lbs ($210 non-refundable per dog, 2 dogs max) Overnight: Main House: - Full-over-full bunks with full trundle and twin with trundle in 1st floor bunk room; shared bath - King in 2nd floor primary bedroom; private bath - King in 2nd floor guest bedroom; private bath - Queen in 2nd floor guest bedroom; private bath Carriage House: - Twin-over-twin bunks in 1st floor guest bedroom; private bath - Queen in 1st floor guest bedroom; private bath - Queen in 2nd floor primary bedroom; private bath Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
